body:
Adds the reproducible neutral workflow measurement harness and immutable baseline. Measured source `83d7e8f52df92d10d3ff85709da6eff3231a0b06` completed 18 fresh read processes/54 cycles over 1/20-artifact layouts and 0/8/55 terminal histories, two negative/recovery tails and six fresh-catalog workflows. Raw observations, source hashes and bounded CPU/RSS/I/O/request distributions are retained in `docs/plans/lab-workflow-reliability/reports/m4-workflow-baseline/`.

Independent verification preserves all 64 baseline files and verifies the 63-file evidence manifest. Current head `9d62ef6ad07f4970afdb8ecb9f8bab79584224b2` passed both lifecycle jobs; the reviewed job completed all 168 steps, with 1,639 Python tests and 72 skips, the PostgreSQL phase gate, and later existing browser gates. The baseline remains attributed to its measured source; subsequent compositions repair test fixtures only. No training, mutable-runtime reuse, OS/PG-cache coldness, speedup or scientific acceptance is inferred. The separately measured bounded collection candidate and explicit consumer are PR109/110. Original pilot failures remain recorded, including the unowned schema whose identity was never guessed.
